vb_textbox.text: Keep your fingers on the s, k and space bar at all times. Have in your mind which gnome you will pick and have your finger ready to press. Change up your choices every now and them. I went for tall hats then short hats.. but it didnt seem to matter which one i went for.. the number varied. press the space bar as soon as you see the basket. it doesnt seem to make a difference to the number. stay calm if you get timed out on choosing the gnomes or pressing the space bar. keep your cool and steadily choose. try not to watch the score. It doesnt matter if you win or not. The colours are nice and its an interesting game. 200 rounds seems long and it feels it at times but it doesnt take that  long. Enjoy yourself. I did. Good luck.
